Plane window breaks mid-flight, passenger partially ejected

A passenger's upper body was ejected from an airplane after a window broke at an altitude of 30,000 feet. The passenger's wife reportedly held onto their legs to prevent them from falling out. The incident occurred during a flight, though further details about the specific flight or its destination are not provided.
